name: ArtifactsBench
abstract: ArtifactsBench evaluates interactive visual code generation with emphasis on visual quality, dynamic behavior, and interaction integrity. This page uses the AVG score from the main result table.
contributions: The benchmark explicitly evaluates visual quality, dynamic feedback, and interaction integrity rather than only executability.
The paper reports strong agreement between its automated evaluation and human preference rankings from WebDev Arena.
method: This work targets interactive visual artifacts such as web apps, small tools, games, and SVG generation, which are poorly covered by traditional code benchmarks.
It executes generated code, captures temporal screenshots, and evaluates code, visuals, and interaction with checklist-guided multimodal judges.
The paper builds 1,825 tasks and shows strong agreement with human preference, making ArtifactsBench a practical benchmark for user-facing code generation.
